cases.text: Problem: support agents spend hours triaging 3000 tickets per month, so customers wait and urgent issues are missed; the user value is faster routing. Success metrics: baseline median resolution time, a measurable target of 20 percent lower, and triage accuracy above 90 percent against labelled tickets. Risks: hallucination, misclassification of urgent tickets, privacy of customer data in prompts, and bias against rare categories. Fallback: below a confidence threshold the ticket is escalated to a human reviewer, with a feedback loop to review errors weekly.
